h1.body: Create your account, name your building, compound or organization, and start a 30-day free trial. No payment details.

h2.body: Follow the checklist: blocks, units, people, licenses. Import from Excel if you already keep records.

h3.title: Collect on autopilot
h3.body: Expenses become charges, residents get receipts, and Abniyah sends the monthly payment reminders for you.

pricing.p2: Unlimited managers and residents per unit

landing.aboutBody1: Abniyah is built and operated by Tatawwor, a Beirut-based technology company whose team earned its experience in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom. We build it the way we run our own systems: security enforced in the database, daily backups, and no shortcuts.

privacy.q: Who can see my building's data?
privacy.a: Only your building's authorized managers see its residents and finances, and residents see their own units. Access rules are enforced at the database level on every request. Details are in our Privacy Policy.

arabic.q: Does it really work in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. The full app, including notifications, works in Arabic with proper right-to-left layout. Every user picks their own language.

payments.a: Today, money changes hands as your building prefers (cash, transfer) and management records it in Abniyah; residents see their balance and receipts instantly. Direct in-app payment via Whish is on our roadmap.

price.q: What does it cost after the trial?
price.a: One monthly price for the whole building, based on its size: from $85 a month for up to 20 units, $105 up to 40, $150 up to 70, and on up. Larger buildings pay less per unit. Pay yearly and you get 12 months for the price of 10. Above 500 units we agree a price with you. Every feature is included in all three languages, with no hidden extras.

residents.a: Their own login showing their balance, charges and receipts, building announcements and meetings, the ability to report maintenance issues with photos, and notifications on WhatsApp or email in their language.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready to run your building like a pro?
landing.ctaBody: Set up your building today. Free for 30 days, and your data stays yours.

f1.title: The building book
f1.body: Every expense, charge and payment in one ledger. The compound view and each block reconcile to the cent.

f2.title: Billing & collections
f2.body: Collect fixed prepaid amounts or bill actual costs, postpaid. Owners see their balance; managers see who has paid.

f3.title: WhatsApp & email updates
f3.body: Receipts, new charges and prepaid asks reach residents on WhatsApp and email, in Arabic, English and French.

f4.title: Issues & maintenance
f4.body: Residents report problems with photos; managers track them from reported to resolved.

f5.title: Meetings & decisions
f5.body: Schedule building meetings with calendar invites, keep minutes and decisions where everyone finds them.

f6.title: Compounds & portfolios
f6.body: One account for a single building, a compound of blocks, or a whole management company.

dues.flatFeeNote: Flat fee: the full base amount is charged every period, regardless of current balance.
dues.poolPartyHint: Billed to the tenant where a unit is leased, to the owner otherwise.
dues.ownerPoolHint: Charged to owners only, every period, on top of the recurring budget. Leave at 0 if there is none. For a one-time amount use a special charge instead.
dues.customPartyHint: Recurring is billed to the tenant where a unit is leased; owner-only is always the owner's.
dues.offBudgetNote: A one-time charge outside the recurring budget, allocated across units, with its own due date. Use it when the fund needs money now rather than at the next generation. A party's carry-in applies to the total of their recurring and special amounts.
dues.billToOwnerHint: Charged to owners regardless of who lives there. Use for capital work, which follows ownership.
dues.billToTenantHint: The running budget follows the occupant: the tenant where a unit is leased, the owner where it is not.
dues.arrearsBlocked: Issuing prepayments is turned off until it is switched.
dues.arrearsOneOff: To bill a one-time cost on a postpaid building, record it as an expense and allocate it in
dues.trueUpOnHint: Each unit is asked its base adjusted for what it already owes or has paid ahead. Use this for a normal period.
dues.trueUpOffHint: Every unit is asked the full amount, even one sitting on credit. Use this to collect an unbudgeted cost now. The credit is absorbed by the next trued-up period.
dues.flatAskNote: Flat ask: the full amount is charged to every unit, regardless of its balance.
dues.owedHint: What each party still owes across every open period, the same figure the reminders chase. Paid amounts are that party's payments since their oldest open period.
dues.pickUnitsHint: {{count}} selected. The amount is split across these only.
dues.budgetLinesHint: One row per expense type: fuel, elevator maintenance, gardening… The total of the lines is what gets split across units.
dues.needLines: Add at least one budget line with an amount.
dues.cancelBudgetConfirm: Cancel the budget "{{label}}"? Its unpaid asks are withdrawn and residents are notified. Payments already made stay on the ledger as credit.
dues.cancelBudgetPaidWarn: {{amount}} already paid against this budget will remain as a unit credit.
dues.budgetCancelled: Budget cancelled and its asks withdrawn
dues.balancesChanged: Balances changed while this budget was open. The amounts have been refreshed; please review and issue again.

invites.title: Invitation: unit {{unit}}, {{building}}
invites.accepted: Invitation accepted. The unit is now on your account.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Who has which management role, at which scope

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account and how we reach you
settings.languageHint: Applies on every device you sign in from, and to your WhatsApp notifications.
settings.whatsappNeedsPhone: Save your mobile number first. WhatsApp needs somewhere to reach you.
settings.pushHint: Get alerts on this device even when Abniyah is closed: new charges, payments received, issues and meeting reminders. Separate from email and WhatsApp; turning it on here affects this device only.
settings.pushDenied: iOS is blocking notifications for Abniyah. Turn them on in the iPhone Settings app under Notifications, then try again.
settings.pushNoToken: iOS refused to issue a device token for this build. That is a signing or entitlement problem, not something you can fix here.
settings.pushTimeout: No response from Apple within 15 seconds. This can be a slow or restricted network. Try again on a different connection.
settings.pushSaveFailed: Apple issued a token but saving it failed.
settings.bioLockHint: Open Abniyah with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode instead of typing your password. Asked once when you open the app, including after restarting your phone, and not every time you switch away. Signing out still requires your password next time.
settings.bioUnavailable: Face ID / biometrics aren't set up on this device.
settings.channelRequired: Keep at least one notification channel on (email or WhatsApp), otherwise building notices can't reach you.
settings.emailNote: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. The change only takes effect once you click it.
settings.emailConfirmSent: Confirmation sent to {{email}}. Click the link to finish the change.
settings.pwTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
settings.cropHint: Drag to reposition, pinch or use the slider to zoom.
settings.mfaNote: Add a second step at sign-in: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, …). Optional but strongly recommended for admins.
settings.mfaScanHint: Scan it with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
settings.mfaManualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
settings.mfaInvalidCode: That code didn't work. Try again
settings.mfaDisableConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication? Your account will then be protected by your password only.

metering.legacyReadOnly: This cycle was posted by the old metering - it is read-only history.
metering.latestOnly: Only the latest cycle can be edited - later cycles chain from it.
metering.modelMbmDesc: Each cycle bills exactly what you bought that period, split by what the meters measured. Money in = money out - the fund never carries fuel. Best when you buy roughly what you burn.
metering.modelWaDesc: Each cycle bills what was consumed, priced at the running average cost of the tank. Rates stay smooth when prices jump, and the tank's value shows in your fund as stock on hand. Best for big tanks.
metering.setupIntro: Choose how consumption is priced. The choice applies from the next cycle; every posted cycle keeps the rules it was billed with.
metering.purchaseTypeRequired: Choose which expense type the purchases are recorded under.
metering.purchaseTypeHint: Record every delivery in Expenses under THIS type, with its quantity - the cycle prices itself only from those, inside its dates. Keep it separate from the metered type so bills stay clean.
metering.initialBilledQ: Residents already paid for this stock
metering.initialHint: If the tank was already billed to residents, its starting value is zero - the blended rate returns their prepayment as it is consumed.
metering.waExitBlocked: The tank still holds {{value}} of fund money. Run it down or write it off before switching to Month by Month.
metering.purchasesNone: No matching purchase invoices in these dates yet.
metering.lossAlarmBody: Losses are {{pct}}% of consumption - above the alarm threshold. Billing them spreads the cost over everyone. Investigate the leak, or continue?
metering.noMeteredHint: Mark generator or water as metered in the building settings:
metering.warnings: Some readings go backwards or the stock math is negative - those rows were clamped to zero. Double-check before finalizing.
metering.deleteConfirm: Delete this cycle? Its charges are removed and balances move back. Under Weighted Average only the latest cycle can be deleted.
metering.deleted: Cycle deleted - its charges were removed.

bylaws.title: Building Rules
bylaws.subtitle: The building rules for {{entity}}, and the shares they fix.
bylaws.referenceOnly: This is the building's reference copy. The legal original is the notarized document registered with the Land Registry.
bylaws.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
bylaws.confirmDelete: Remove version {{version}}? The file stays in storage but the record is deleted.
bylaws.empty: No building rules on file yet
bylaws.emptyAdminHint: Upload the building rules so residents can read them, and so the share table below has a stated source.
bylaws.emptyResidentHint: Your building admin has not uploaded the building rules yet.
bylaws.supersedes: This becomes v{{next}} and supersedes v{{n}}. The earlier version is kept.
bylaws.effectiveDateHint: The date the general assembly adopted this text, not the date you upload it.
bylaws.sharesTitle: Shares fixed by the building rules
bylaws.sharesHint: How every expense is split. Each unit's share comes from the building rules; add the article it appears in from the Structure page.
bylaws.pickEntity: Pick a building or compound to see its rules.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.blurb: Abniyah is in closed testing with a handful of buildings in Lebanon. Leave your email and we will tell you the day it opens.
waitlist.thanks: You're on the list. We'll be in touch.
waitlist.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
waitlist.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
waitlist.privacyNote: One email, when we launch. No newsletter, and we do not pass your address to anyone.

lostfound.title: Lost & Found
lostfound.subtitle: Found something in the building? Post it - everyone is notified and the owner can claim it.
lostfound.reportHint: A photo helps people recognize it - you can take one right here.
lostfound.itemTitleExample: e.g. Keys with a red keychain
lostfound.photoHint: Take a photo or choose one
lostfound.posted: Posted. Everyone in the building was notified.
lostfound.empty: Nothing in the lost & found right now.
lostfound.claimBody: Confirm that "{{title}}" is yours. The finder and the building admin will be notified.
lostfound.claimed: Claimed. The admin was notified - arrange the pickup.

voting.rulesIntro: Set once per building - every new vote uses these rules. You can change them any time; votes already open keep the rules they started with.
voting.rulesSnapshotNote: Changing the rules never affects a vote that is already open.
voting.title: Voting
voting.subtitle: The committee puts a question to the building - every resident gets a say.
voting.question: The question
voting.questionExample: e.g. Approve the new generator provider?
voting.rulesHint: Quorum is the minimum turnout for the vote to count. The threshold is the share of cast votes the winner needs - 50 is a simple majority, 66 a supermajority.
voting.created: The vote is open. Residents were notified.
voting.resultsAfterClose: Results are revealed when voting closes.
voting.closeBody: Voting stops immediately and the results become final.
voting.needTwoOptions: Give the vote a question and at least two options.
voting.closesInFuture: The closing time must be in the future.

fund.scopeSwitchToBlock: Each block gets its own cash box. Count each block's box and set its opening cash - the compound-level opening no longer applies. Compound-wide money will ask which block's box paid.
fund.scopeSwitchToCompound: One box for the whole compound. Count the combined cash and set one opening - the per-block openings no longer apply.
fund.scopeSwitched: Fund scope changed. Now set the opening cash.
fund.paidFromRequired: Pick which block's box this money belongs to.
fund.unattributedHint: Recorded at compound level before the per-block switch, so it counts in no block's box. Edit each one and say which block paid.
fund.cashHint: Opening cash, plus every payment and other income, minus every expense, outflow and refund.
fund.creditsHintArrears: Overpayments and prepayments. In the drawer, but theirs: future charges will consume it.
fund.creditsHintDues: Prepaid amounts not yet consumed by expenses.
fund.fundPaidNote: {{amount}} of expenses were paid from the fund rather than billed to residents.
fund.unreconciledHint: Its charges plus the part paid from the fund do not add up to the amount. Open it and say who bears the rest.
fund.noEntries: No other income or outflows yet. Unit payments and expenses are already counted above.
fund.counterpartyExample: e.g. the antenna company, the bank
fund.incomeHint: Money in that did not come from a unit: rent from a third party, bank interest, a donation.
fund.outflowHint: Money out that is not an expense: a cash refund handed over, a withdrawal to the bank.
fund.outflowExample: e.g. Cash moved to the bank account
fund.openingHint: What was in the drawer on the day the book started. Leave the date empty to count it from the beginning.
fund.pay_residents_hint: Billed to units by the split below.
fund.pay_fund_hint: Paid from cash on hand. Nobody is billed.
fund.remainderAsk: Say what it is: paid from the building fund, or a split that needs fixing. Nothing is saved until you do.
fund.remainderNamed: The building fund bears this part. The rest is billed as shown.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: The facade, the generator, the lift. What was estimated, what has been spent.
projects.name: Project
projects.noExpenses: No expense has been tagged to this project yet.
projects.none: No projects yet. A project is an estimate with a name; the expenses you record against it become its actual cost.
projects.descriptionPlaceholder: What is being done, by whom, and what the committee agreed.
projects.howActualWorks: This form only sets the estimate. The actual spend is never typed anywhere - it adds up automatically from the expenses you tag to this project in Finance.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project? Its expenses stay in the book, untagged.
projects.pickBlock: Pick a block, or apply it to the whole compound.

collect.title: Collect
collect.subtitle: Write the receipt for what you took. Nothing else to see here.
collect.ownerNote: Receipts land on the owner’s account. If a tenant paid, finance can move it afterwards.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.subtitle: The lift, the generator, the tank. What the building has, and everything attached to each one.
amenities.name: Name
amenities.none: No amenities yet. Add the lift and the generator first: contracts, inspections and expenses can then be attached to them.
amenities.retireLabel: Retired (keep for history, hide from forms)
amenities.deleteConfirm: Delete this amenity? Contracts, inspections and expenses stay, unlinked.
